  description = "Allow inbound PostgreSQL traffic"

  ingress {
    from_port   = 5432
    to_port     = 5432
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }
}

resource "aws_db_instance" "airbyte-postgres" {
  instance_class = "db.t3.micro"
  allocated_storage = 500
  engine = "postgres"
  engine_version = "15.0"
  db_subnet_group_name = aws_db_subnet_group.airbyte-db-subnet-group.name
  vpc_security_group_ids = [aws_security_group.airbyte-security-group.id]
  iam_roles = [aws_iam_role.airbyte-rds-role.arn]
}

resource "aws_db_subnet_group" "airbyte-db-subnet-group" {
  name = "airbyte-db-subnet-group"
  subnet_ids = [aws_subnet.airbyte-subnet-1.id, aws_subnet.airbyte-subnet-2.id]
}

resource "aws_iam_role" "airbyte-rds-role" {
  name = "airbyte-rds-role"
  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Action = "sts:AssumeRole"
        Effect = "Allow"
        Principal = {
          Service = "rds.amazonaws.com"
        }
      }
    ]
  })
}
